title: Maratón de Buenos Aires 2026 — Reglamento / bases
claims: The 2026 regulations describe 42.195 km on an urban asphalt circuit homologated by World Athletics and distinguished with the World Athletics Label Race label.
Runners must be at least 18 years old on race day; minors may not take part even in a pushchair or assisted device.
The start is at 07:00 and the official finish closes at 13:00, with an official maximum time of 6:00:00 that may not be exceeded.
Aid and food stations begin at km 5 and continue at 2.5 km intervals: 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20, 22.5, 25, 27.5, 30, 32.5, 35, 37.5, 40 and 42.195 km.

The regulations promise hydration and food including fruit from km 5 but do not assign products station by station; Infobae's 2026 preview specifies water and isotonic drink every 2.5 km and banana at km 20 and km 30.

Race-kit collection is only at Expo Running 42K in Parque Sarmiento on Friday 18 September 2026 (12:00–20:00) and Saturday 19 September 2026 (10:00–18:00); there is no general race-day pickup or kit delivery, but a third party may collect with the runner's QR and both identity documents.
The paid VIP package includes race-day kit collection up to 30 minutes before the start; lockers are a separate paid service, and the bag check accepts clothing only and not valuables.
The regulations provide wheelchair, visually impaired B1, B2/B3, assisted-athletics and other disability categories, with one free guide; handbike is excluded because it belongs to para-cycling.
The event has no parking service and parking is prohibited on the streets used by the race; unauthorised vehicles, bicycles, skates and other wheeled followers are prohibited.
Runners must leave the finish chute promptly, may not warm up in front of the start line, and face disqualification for either breach.
Awards are trophies for the top three in the conventional, wheelchair and visually impaired categories, with a minimum of five entrants in a category; the regulations list no prize money.

verification.note: 官方 2026 规程 PDF 全文复核；分批出发、VIP 领物、残障组别与终点通道条款为新增。补给品类官方未逐站列明，Infobae 赛前稿作为二级证据。
